Task Guide:


Task: Bulk Modulus of Copper
Description: Calculate the bulk modulus of copper by computing the full elastic stiffness tensor using finite deformation and stress analysis. Use the Embedded Atom Method (EAM) potential for copper. Apply small finite deformations in each of the six independent strain modes (ε₁ to ε₆ in Voigt notation: ε₁ = ε<sub>xx</sub>, ε₂ = ε<sub>yy</sub>, ε₃ = ε<sub>zz</sub>, ε₄ = 2ε<sub>yz</sub>, ε₅ = 2ε<sub>xz</sub>, ε₆ = 2ε<sub>xy</sub>), one at a time. From the resulting stress-strain data, compute the full 6×6 elastic stiffness matrix (C<sub>ij</sub>). Report the bulk modulus in GPa via Voigt averaging.

Required submission format:
numerical value without units (eg. 56.00)


Available input data:
All the potentials, can be found at /potentials/. Note that in case of reaxff potentials, pair style 'reax/c' has been renamed to 'reaxff' and always use NULL for the control file (cfile), for example, this syntax is correct : pair_style reaxff NULL.

- units: metal
- pbc: true
- minimiser: conjugate gradient
- energy_tolerance: 1e-10
- force_tolerance: 1e-10
- maximum_iterations: 100000.0
- maximum_evaluations: 100000.0
- materials_project_id: mp-30
- atom_style: atomic
- deformation_step_size: 1e-06
- total_deformation: -1 * (deformation_step_size * lattice parameter)

IMPORTANT: You have access to filesystem tools. All files will be saved in your isolated workspace.
 Save all the files in /results/2_AUGUST_2025/claude_35/tool_calling/bulk_modulus/brief/tasks/copper_bulk_modulus_trial_3 when using tools use this path.

For that, answer with: "Final Answer: <your answer>". It is very important to follow this format.

Now, let's create the LAMMPS input script for elastic constants calculation. We'll write a script that:
1. Sets up the simulation
2. Performs energy minimization
3. Calculates elastic constants using finite deformations

function.name: write_file
function.arguments:
{"path": "/results/2_AUGUST_2025/claude_35/tool_calling/bulk_modulus/brief/tasks/copper_bulk_modulus_trial_3/in.elastic", "content": "# LAMMPS input script for elastic constants calculation

# Initialization
units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p p

# Read structure
read_data Cu.data

# EAM potential for Cu
pair_style eam
pair_coeff * * /potentials/Cu_u3.eam

# Energy minimization
minimize 1e-10 1e-10 100000 100000

# Store initial box dimensions
variable L0 equal lx
variable tmp equal ly
variable ly0 equal ${tmp}
variable tmp equal lz
variable lz0 equal ${tmp}

# Define deformation size
variable up equal 1.0e-6
variable down equal -${up}

# Output
thermo_style custom step pe lx ly lz press pxx pyy pzz pxy pxz pyz
thermo 1

# Elastic constants calculation
# Initial state
fix 3 all box/relax iso 0.0
minimize 1e-10 1e-10 100000 100000
unfix 3

# Store stress components for initial state
variable tmp equal pxx
variable pxx0 equal ${tmp}
variable tmp equal pyy
variable pyy0 equal ${tmp}
variable tmp equal pzz
variable pzz0 equal ${tmp}
variable tmp equal pxy
variable pxy0 equal ${tmp}
variable tmp equal pxz
variable pxz0 equal ${tmp}
variable tmp equal pyz
variable pyz0 equal ${tmp}

# Deform the box
variable delta equal ${up}
variable deltaxy equal ${delta}
variable deltaxz equal ${delta}
variable deltayz equal ${delta}

# C11
fix 1 all deform 1 x delta ${delta} remap x
minimize 1e-10 1e-10 100000 100000
variable C11 equal -(pxx-${pxx0})/${delta}
unfix 1

# C22
fix 1 all deform 1 y delta ${delta} remap x
minimize 1e-10 1e-10 100000 100000
variable C22 equal -(pyy-${pyy0})/${delta}
unfix 1

# C33
fix 1 all deform 1 z delta ${delta} remap x
minimize 1e-10 1e-10 100000 100000
variable C33 equal -(pzz-${pzz0})/${delta}
unfix 1

# C44
fix 1 all deform 1 yz delta ${deltayz} remap x
minimize 1e-10 1e-10 100000 100000
variable C44 equal -(pyz-${pyz0})/${deltayz}
unfix 1

# C55
fix 1 all deform 1 xz delta ${deltaxz} remap x
minimize 1e-10 1e-10 100000 100000
variable C55 equal -(pxz-${pxz0})/${deltaxz}
unfix 1

# C66
fix 1 all deform 1 xy delta ${deltaxy} remap x
minimize 1e-10 1e-10 100000 100000
variable C66 equal -(pxy-${pxy0})/${deltaxy}
unfix 1

# Output elastic constants
print "C11 = ${C11} GPa"
print "C22 = ${C22} GPa"
print "C33 = ${C33} GPa"
print "C44 = ${C44} GPa"
print "C55 = ${C55} GPa"
print "C66 = ${C66} GPa"

# Calculate Bulk Modulus (Voigt average)
variable B equal (${C11}+${C22}+${C33})/9.0
print "Bulk Modulus = ${B} GPa""}
